sourceEntry: 2026-10-20 — Portal switches and assigned pricelist editor
releaseSummary: Portal settings use enable/disable switches and an Edit link opens the selected pricelist. Existing customer access is preserved. All-off defaults for new accounts require the separately approved database migration.

moduleImpact.notes: Updated as part of Portal switches and assigned pricelist editor.

migrationNotes: No manual data migration is required for this release.
